## silex-forge v1.7.1

Security and reliability hardening for visibility, keyed shares, and Cloudflare deploys.

### Highlights

- Strict fail-closed visibility and compensated KV mutations
- CSRF protection and confined `/s/` asset routing
- Full `pages.dev` application lock
- Cloudflare preflight, online doctor, and safe Wrangler OAuth fallback
- Pages plain-variable preservation during Direct Upload
- Automated TypeScript, Python, shell, and credential-scan CI

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/go-silex/silex-forge/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for full details.
